question: Does increasing attention head count improve coherence at fixed embed_dim=64? Is there a head count that collapses (too many for the width) or a sweet spot?
predicted_outcome: 4 heads outperforms 1 head by separating positional and semantic attention streams. 8 heads may overfit at this scale (head_dim=8 is very narrow). 2 heads may be the Pareto optimum for embed_dim=64, balancing expressiveness and per-head capacity. We expect a non-monotonic relationship.
seeds: a mystery game where memory works backwards
a survival game where sacrifice is the economy
a horror game with procedurally generated grief

Low template count (2) with slot_ratio coherence and context injection enabled — tests the Pareto optimum hypothesis where fewer, wider representational slots with full context access maximizes per-slot capacity and coherence at embed_dim=64
